hypotheses.representation: An exact source-free Boolean Möbius transform of modular addition followed by 4-bit rotate has maximum algebraic degree ≤4 in the eight operand bits; prove on the complete independent 256-combination domain, not using consumed 91-94 sources.
hypotheses.information: FIT on 24×8 observed event transitions contains <=192 labels for each unknown two-nibble mapping with 256 input pairs. Compute full 163-column degree<=4 design rank on exact true source pair and selected pair using only FIT. Construct an explicit nullspace coefficient witness equal on ALL FIT inputs but differing on an unobserved one; such a witness proves that FIT does not identify a unique degree<=4 polynomial even with known pair.
hypotheses.selection: Compare chosen source-register pair to independently source-only authored true wiring solely AFTER both frozen learners have finished; record alternate consistent pairs. If different true vs selected, classify pair selection as a possible additional failure cause, not necessarily the unique cause.
hypotheses.optimization: Independently check that a consistent polynomial for the true source pair exists using an independent GF2 solver. Exact full FIT residual=0 for both models and source-pair representability rule out optimization failure to fit, but not poor generalizing optimizer or its sparsity prior.
